title.zh: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin
title.en: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin

current_state.zh: SoFi launched SoFi Earn (SOFIE), which it bills as the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers, offering 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance and one-to-one conversion into the bank's SoFiUSD stablecoin for on-chain spending.
current_state.en: SoFi launched SoFi Earn (SOFIE), which it bills as the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers, offering 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance and one-to-one conversion into the bank's SoFiUSD stablecoin for on-chain spending.
